records.title: Coinbase Global Exchange accepted collateral assets
records.summary: Coinbase Global Exchange lists XRP among assets accepted as collateral for perpetual-futures margin, alongside BTC, ETH, SOL, EURC and other assets.
records.limitations: No XRP collateral balance, customer-level usage, haircut, ADQ cap or jurisdiction-specific availability is disclosed on this page. Eligibility is not evidence of material posted collateral.

records.title: Coinbase Global Exchange cross-collateral valuation and liquidation rules
records.summary: Collateral value is notional value multiplied by collateral weight; weight equals one minus the greater of base haircut and closeout-horizon haircut. Asset usage is capped as a percentage of average daily quantity. Collateral can be automatically liquidated when portfolio margin falls below maintenance margin.
records.limitations: Per-asset XRP haircut, closeout-horizon schedule, ADQ cap and actual collateral balances are not published on the help page.

records.title: Coinbase crypto-backed loans — eligible XRP collateral and Morpho structure
records.summary: Eligible customers can borrow USDC against XRP through Morpho on Base; Coinbase provides the interface while Morpho provides on-chain lending. Eligible collateral and limits vary by region and loan type. Coinbase terms state loan proceeds cannot be used for trading on Coinbase.
records.limitations: No XRP-specific loan balance or Circle-specific lender allocation is disclosed. This is separate from Coinbase Global Exchange derivatives collateral.

records.title: Coinbase backup collateral requirements — cbXRP on Base
records.summary: Coinbase documents cbXRP on Base as the collateral asset for XRP-backed loans and publishes contract address 0xcb585250f852c6c6bf90434ab21a00f02833a4af.
records.limitations: Documentation confirms product mapping, not the current amount of cbXRP collateral in any Morpho market or whether a liquidator redeemed or sold collateral.

records.title: Circle Arc mainnet launch — validator, exchange-access and credit-layer participants
records.summary: Circle describes Arc as a USDC-gas Layer 1 with institutional validators including SBI Group; Coinbase is listed among exchange-access partners; Morpho is listed as a credit-layer participant. Circle describes more than $74B USDC circulation at launch and more than 100 applications/builders.
records.limitations: Company announcement with forward-looking statements. Arc is distinct from XRPL; membership does not prove an XRP investment, direct Coinbase-SBI transaction, or displacement of XRPL flows. Arc's validator set is permissioned.

records.title: XRP perpetual futures — seven-exchange market snapshot
records.summary: At 05:40 UTC, TradRadar displayed XRP mark price $1.2454 (-1.06% over 24h), $1.85B open interest across seven exchanges (+0.28% over 24h), OI-weighted funding +0.0058% per eight hours, at least $2.89M liquidations (longs $1.82M, shorts $1.07M), and 78.5% long accounts across five exchanges.
records.limitations: 15-minute delay; provider-specific contract coverage; liquidation figures are lower bounds; long-account ratio is not notional exposure. No predictive feature admitted.

records.title: XRP exchange balances — 701 publicly attributed wallets across 24 exchanges
records.summary: The page reports 22.37B XRP across 701 publicly attributed exchange wallets as of 2026-10-30 08:00 UTC. Binance is 2.58B across 153 wallets with a same-wallet seven-day change of -173.2M; Coinbase is 5.84B across 358 wallets. The totals include cold storage and explicitly include 327.4M Binance-Peg XRP reserve and 151.4M cbXRP backing reserves, not customer-tradable balances.
records.limitations: XRPSCAN public labels and a specific tracked wallet universe; not an official exchange reserve statement or free-float measure. Same-wallet history is daily and the five Binance incident source addresses have not been individually crosswalked to this set.
